name: PHP CLI
meaning: The command-line interface for executing PHP outside a web request.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: dynamic typing
meaning: The type belongs to a value; an ordinary variable can later hold a different type of value.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: strict equality
meaning: A comparison that requires matching types as well as equal values.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: truthiness
meaning: The boolean result PHP assigns to a value when a condition or explicit boolean conversion uses it.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: interpolation
meaning: Inserting a value into supported string syntax rather than printing the variable name literally.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: PHP array
meaning: An ordered map whose keys are integers or strings and whose entries hold values.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: array key coercion
meaning: PHP conversion rules that turn some supplied array keys into integer or string keys.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: foreach
meaning: A loop that visits the entries of an array or another iterable value.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: PHP reference alias
meaning: A second name for the same variable content rather than an independent assigned value.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: PHP null coalescing
meaning: Choosing a fallback for a missing or null value while preserving other values such as zero.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: match expression
meaning: An expression that selects a result using strict matching without switch-style fallthrough.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: type declaration
meaning: A declared parameter, property or return-value type enforced using the relevant PHP typing rules.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: strict scalar typing
meaning: A per-file mode that changes scalar argument and result typing rules rather than validating every business constraint.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: named argument
meaning: An argument associated with a declared parameter by its name.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: PHP variadic parameter
meaning: A parameter that collects a variable number of arguments into an array.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: nullable type
meaning: A type declaration that explicitly permits null as well as its non-null type.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: arrow function
meaning: A short anonymous function that returns one expression and automatically captures outer variables by value.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: finally
meaning: A block used for cleanup as control leaves a try/catch, including normal and exceptional paths.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: object instance
meaning: An object created from a class and accessed through its identifier.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: promoted property

context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: controlled state
meaning: A design exposing validated operations rather than unrestricted field writes.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: uninitialized property

name: shallow readonly boundary

context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: method override
meaning: A subclass implementation of an inherited overridable method.
context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: trait conflict resolution

context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: backed enum

context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: static state

context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: namespace alias

context: PHP language and standard-library semantics; CLI core and explicit web boundaries.

name: one-time loading

name: autoload callback

name: shallow object clone

name: IteratorAggregate

name: first-class callable

name: attribute metadata
